content.short: Spark provides utility for DAI holders through DeFi infrastructure projects including SparkLend, sDAI, and SparkConduits.
content.description: Spark delivers practical utility for DAI holders by bringing together a suite of DeFi infrastructure projects, including SparkLend, sDAI, and SparkConduits. SparkLend is a DAI-centric money market protocol that pools liquidity from Maker and integrates with leading DeFi protocols to support efficient lending and borrowing alongside yield opportunities. The Spark ecosystem is developed and managed by a community closely connected to Maker and other DAOs, fostering collaboration and alignment across the broader DeFi landscape.
